limitations.codeclone: Real exact-type data-flow chains, balanced at every paper depth. Recovered/regenerated suites share witnesses and are not independent historical CodeWalk suites. Deep chains use a loop-free source subset to bound native execution; this selection differs from historical mining. Depth-10 negatives are placed last and require a real whole-chain witness.
limitations.bugfixing: All 568 original published task definitions restored with exact groups, commits, images and patches; not all original image environments freshly replayed locally. Preparation recipes are separate from model inputs.
limitations.verus: 100 original L1 task definitions recovered with actual upstream proofs; two references add an immutable-input loop invariant for current Verus. Higher-level chains are new, conservative compatible-vector compositions, not original historical chains. Toolchain differs from the initial experiment.
limitations.bigo: Actual CodeComplex functions with source-label agreement, limited AST cost analysis and empirical size-transfer checks. Multiple distinct functions from one problem may enter the pool; each chain uses at most one atom per source problem. This differs from the historical 277-atom one-per-problem pool. No cubic/np atoms.

alignment_status: failed; this report records implementation checks, not paper-method compatibility
